item.title: Building Products, Understanding Customers
item.description: I design and implement agentic systems for Jobdream’s marketplace-seller platform and am building an agentic game creation and publishing platform. Previously, I built a paid investment education community. My work spans agent architecture, implementation, and product validation.

item.title: What Remains Valuable When Answers Become Cheap?
item.description: I built an investment education audience on YouTube, grew it beyond 9,000 subscribers, and offered a private Telegram community at $30 a month. As AI became better at explaining concepts, I began questioning what I should continue to offer. That question now follows me into building a game creation and publishing platform and engineering work for a merchant-agent platform.
